thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-queue (SEV2) — queue backlog > 95% for 6m. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
pagerduty: PagerDuty assigned INC12345 to SRE Oncall (emma). escalation policy: main -> secondary in 12m.
emma: ack @channel — looking into it now. initial checks on autoscaler and nodepools. tagging @ryan for infra assist.
ryan: on my way. brief: control plane shows provisioning timeouts, nodepool create requests failing with quota errors. suspect provider CPU quota hit in us-west-2.
marta: FYI customer-impact: increased latency and intermittent 504s reported on hosted API routes. support already seeing spikes in error rates.
emma: mitigation options: (A) manual spin additional nodepool from partner spare pool, (B) scale down batch/background workers to free capacity, (C) throttle low-priority traffic / enable fallback smaller model. planning A+B in parallel.
support-jay: composing customer note now: "We're investigating increased latency due to capacity constraints; engineers are actively mitigating." will post to status shortly.
ryan: running manual provision: `gcloud container node-pools create prod-burst --zone=us-west2-a --node-count=3 --machine-type=n2-standard-8` — response: ERROR: QUOTA_EXCEEDED: CPUs.
emma: confirmed quota block. ryan, can you attempt scale-down of batch workers to free CPUs? `kubectl scale deploy batch-workers --replicas=1`
ryan: scaling batch-workers down. `kubectl get pods` shows termination starts. freeing ~16 CPUs.
marta: good short-term move. if queues start draining, we'll hold PD. if not, escalate to cloud-quotas and use partner pool.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: escalation timer at 6m. auto-escalate to secondary on 12m.
dave: joining call — I can request partner pool allocation and have a quick ticket to cloud-quotas@cloudprovider with priority. pinging them now.
ryan: freed CPUs accepted by cluster, starting nodepool create again. `gcloud` returned 202 Accepted, provisioning.
emma: monitoring queue. visible drop in inflight backlog from 97% -> 62% over 3m.
marta: support update: "We’ve applied mitigations; latency trending down. We'll continue monitoring and update customers in 15 minutes."
dave: partner pool approved, but we didn't need it after batch-worker scale-down. good to keep as contingency.
emma: autoscaler metrics show attach success and pod scheduling resuming. queue drain rate normalized.
incident-bot: Alert threshold cleared for inference-queue backlog.
emma: marking this stable. will keep an eye for 10m, then close PD. action items: 1) create runbook entry for "provider quota exhaustion" 2) add autoscaler alert for 'quota blocked' 3) review low-priority throttles and fallback routing.
marta: filing post-incident note and schedule follow-up with cloud team.
emma: closing PD in 11m if no regressions. great work team. :thumbsup:
